# Banner credits

## Artwork

The foundry scene in `maestro-model-router.jpg` was generated and modified using
artificial intelligence: FLUX.2 [dev] (NVFP4) running locally in ComfyUI, 28 steps,
guidance 3.5, 2560 x 1024. It was reviewed before publication.

How it was made:

1. Text-to-image, seed 240917.
2. Reference-guided edit of step 1, seed 402716: riveted ladles, iron oculus.
3. Hand correction of step 2: the left outlet, its two channels and their ladles
   cooled; the oculus plate darkened to iron.
4. Reference-guided pass over step 3, seed 518204, so the corrections read as one
   photograph.
5. Finishing: pale patches on the oculus plate toned down, and three glyph-shaped
   embers removed by inpainting.

Model stack: `flux2-dev-nvfp4.safetensors`, `mistral_3_small_flux2_fp4_mixed.safetensors`,
`flux2-vae.safetensors`. The FLUX [dev] Model is licensed by Black Forest Labs Inc.
under the FLUX [dev] Non-Commercial License; Black Forest Labs claims no ownership of
outputs.

## Mark and type

- The Maestro mark is an original vector drawing from the Orchestration Maestro brand
  kit.
- The title, tagline and labels are set in HTML, not generated, in
  [Barlow Condensed](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/barlowcondensed),
  SIL Open Font License 1.1.
